SR-30
STEERING - POWER STEERING VANE PUMP
REASSEMBLY
NOTICE:
When using a vise, do not overtighten it.
1. COAT PARTS INDICATED BY ARROWS WITH POWER
STEERING FLUID (See page SR-22)
2. INSTALL VANE PUMP SHAFT WITH VANE PUMP
PULLEY
3. INSTALL SIDE PLATE
(a) Coat 2 new 0-rings with power steering fluid, and install
them to the side plate.
(b) Align the dent of the side plate wlth the dent of the front
housing, and install the side plate.
NOTICE:
Make sure that the side plate is installed facing in the corƭ
rect direction.
N FW<82
4. INSTALL CAM RING
Align the dent of the cam ring with the dent of the side plate, and
install the cam ring with the inscribed mark facing outward.
N
5. INSTALL VANE PUMP ROTOR Inscribed Mark
_ _,,-"--'-v• - {a) Install the vane pump rotor with the inscribed mark facing
Round End outward.
(b) Install a new snap ring to the vane pump shaft.
, \ 6. INSTALL 10 VANE PLATES
Install the 10 vane plates with the round end facing outward.
7. INSTALL REAR HOUSING
}: (a} Coat a new 0-ring with power steering fluid, and install :;;; t ,5 -;_ ,,(
N F08484 it to the rear housing.
(b) Align the straight pin of the rear housing with the dents of
the cam ring, side plate and front housing, and install the
rear housing with the 4 bolls.
Torque: 22 N,m {220 kgf.cm, 16 ft,lbf)
(c) Install the rear bracket with the bolt.
Torque: 44 N,m (440 kgf.cm, 32 ft,lbf)
8. INSTALL OIL PRESSURE SWITCH
Torque: 21 N,m (210 kgf,cm, 15 tt-lbf)
